profile.name: Zach Rodgers
profile.statement: Product designer with over 3 years of experience creating mobile, web, and AI products. My background in industrial design and software development helps me take ideas from early research through to launch.

experience.title: Co-Founder & CTO
experience.description:
• Co-founded an AI parking company and led product design and engineering from concept to launch.
• Designed and shipped mobile and web products, guided by interviews and usability testing.
• Built a conversational assistant that automates parking workflows.
• Led engineers and designers, set priorities, and managed releases. Created the brand and camera hardware for pilots.
• Launched with customers in 2025. The platform processes hundreds of license plates daily.

experience.title: Software Engineer (Contract)
experience.description:
• Designed and built an inventory platform, owning product design, frontend, and backend architecture.
• Worked with Nedco and its customer to improve workflows through interviews, usability tests, and A/B testing.
• Integrated Microsoft Graph and authentication. The product passed a two-week external penetration test and remains under my care.

experience.title: Industrial Design Intern
experience.description:
• Led design of an electric side-by-side and designed vehicle interfaces.
• Built a full-scale prototype for UX testing and contributed to autonomous vehicle projects.

education.title: Industrial Design
education.description: Bachelor of Industrial Design with High Distinction. Teaching Assistant for IDES 3001 from 2023 to 2024.
